notes.title: Chloe the Cat is out now!
notes.content: The wait is finally over! Chloe the Cat pounces onto Steam. Buy now with a launch discount of 20% off for the next 2 weeks!

notes.title: Chloe the Cat Releasing on November 14!
notes.content: The wait is almost over! Chloe the Cat is nearly prepared for her big adventure, and will be available for purchase this coming Thursday, November 14. If you haven't already, check out the free demo for a sneak peak of the full game.

notes.title: Small Update v0.4.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ​Fixed a bug with rebinding controller inputs that caused all rebinds to add the A button to an input instead of the user's desired button.
[*] The game will no longer accept inputs while the Steam overlay is open.
[/list]

notes.title: Chloe the Cat is Steam Deck Compatible
notes.content:
Hi Steam Deck gamers,

As Chloe the Cat natively supports Linux, it is also fully Steam Deck compatible. We are fully committed to supporting the Steam Deck for any and all future updates, including testing on real Steam Deck hardware. So you can enjoy Chloe the Cat and the demo worry free.
